observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 45 stand in the left margin and the locator «p. 156.» (L27) in the right margin. The 5 of the line number 35 is printed broken. The page has no notes.
body L10: the comma after «describe» is printed raised, at the height of the small letters.
body L15: «umbræ» is printed with the ligature æ; elsewhere on the page the word is printed with a and e apart.
body L29: a mark hangs from the foot of the s of «cuius», like a comma joined to it; no comma is read.
body L6, L32: the o of «immersionis» is printed thin, its sides as broken strokes.
body L21: a speck stands under the final s of «obscuritatis»; it is not a sign.
body L39: the m of «morae» is printed broken.
